user.title: Find your Govee H1167
user.description: Home Assistant currently sees {count} unconfigured, connectable H1167 device(s). Select your box. If it is not listed, scan again or choose manual setup. Bluetooth must be enabled in Home Assistant.

manual.title: Enter H1167 Bluetooth address
manual.description: Only use this if your box is not discovered. Find its address using Home Assistant Bluetooth advertisements or another BLE scanner. No address is pre-filled.

error.invalid_address: Use a valid Bluetooth MAC address, such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.device_not_found: The device is no longer visible. Refresh or try manual setup.

abort.not_h1167: This Bluetooth device is not identified as an H1167.
